sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The On-Call Support Policy defines the compensation framework for associates who are required to be available and provide support outside of their regular working hours. This policy applies to associates designated for on-call duties by their reporting manager or project lead.

sections.title: On-Call Compensation Rates
paragraphs: Associates designated for on-call support are compensated as follows: Rs. 800/- per day for on-call duty on weekdays (Monday to Friday). Rs. 1,200/- per day for on-call duty on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) and declared public holidays.
On-call compensation is payable only when the associate is formally designated for on-call duty by the reporting manager and the designation is communicated to the HR team.

sections.title: Eligibility and Designation
paragraphs: Associates are eligible for on-call compensation only when: they have been formally assigned on-call duty by the reporting manager, the on-call roster has been shared with the HR/payroll team, and the associate is reachable and responsive during the designated on-call period.
On-call duty means the associate must be available to respond to calls, messages, or incidents within a defined response time even when not physically present in the office or on active shift.

sections.title: Claiming On-Call Allowance
paragraphs: Associates must submit their on-call duty details through the designated HR system or via the payroll submission process. The reporting manager must approve and validate the on-call claim. Claims must be submitted by the 25th of each month for inclusion in that month's payroll.
Associates who are on leave on a day they are designated on-call will not be eligible for on-call compensation for that day.

sections.title: Additional Provisions
paragraphs: If an associate is called in to work (not just on standby) during on-call hours, additional compensation may be applicable as per the overtime or comp-off policy.
On-call rosters must be planned at least one week in advance. Ad-hoc on-call requests made with less than 24 hours notice must be approved by the department head.
